text: {"features":[{"evidence":"\"7 years ... launching 6 production services\" versus \"3 years ... launching 2 production services\"","name":"Production engineering track services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Bare-minimum history; only a few years and limited service count, with little sense of repeated launch or maintenance ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Solid but modest history; several years or several services, showing normal production exposure."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Strong history; sustained work across scale."}]},{"evidence":"\"Bachelor's degree\" / \"Master's degree\" / \"Doctoral degree\"","name":"Advanced academic credential","description":"Captures the level of formal academic preparation workflow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes having automated some part of vulnerability triage or report handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of a concrete triage assessment work is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Security review is referenced only loosely or indirectly."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes concrete assessment methods such as threat work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Python is absent or only implied."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Python is mentioned briefly, with no sense that it is important to the candidate's
